title: Frequency-dependent capacitance matrix formulation for Fabry--Pérot resonances. Part II: One-dimensional periodic media
summary: We study Bloch resonances of one-dimensional periodic systems of high-contrast resonators beyond the subwavelength regime. An exact transfer-matrix formulation identifies the limiting wavenumbers with the union of the interior Neumann frequencies and the Dirichlet frequencies of the separating intervals. At each fixed reference wavenumber, we introduce a periodic frequency-dependent capacitance matrix whose positive eigenvalues determine all leading square-root splittings in the contrast parameter. A direct cyclic matching expansion proves the approximation, including multiple eigenvalues…
